mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated interest rates reduce corporate profitability and increase discount rates for equity valuations.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it triggers a negative reaction in equity markets due to fears of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE) and low industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * INDPRO) has a Rank IC less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return signal fails in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months and INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.4 million units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of consumer credit (RSAFS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as increased credit availability fuels consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS predicting 60-day returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an aggressive monetary policy response to inflation, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL change * FEDFUNDS change) has a Rank IC less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return signal fails in more than 40% of triggered instances.
